title: Safety OS Common Fields
description: Common fields shared across all Safety OS evidence models (v1). Includes electronic signature schema (v1: schema-only, cryptography deferred to v2), ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management reference, and multilingual nomenclature per meeting decisions 2026-06-17.

agent_id.description: Kebab-case identifier of the Safety OS agent that created or owns the record (e.g. audit-agent, compliance-agent, docs-writer). Must match audit_trail.created_by when an audit trail is present.

workflow_id.description: Identifier of the workflow execution that produced the record: workflow directory slug, optionally domain-qualified ('<slug>' or '<domain>/<slug>', e.g. 'psm/pha-hazop'). Optional for record types that do not originate from a dispatched workflow.

e_signature.description: Electronic signature per 21 CFR Part 11 / KP-GMP equivalent. v1 includes schema-only; cryptographic_hash is null until v2 PKI/HSM integration.

signer_id.description: Employee identifier of signer (personal data — PIPA 개인정보보호법 applies)

signer_role.description: Organizational role of the signer. GxP records use QA/QC/production roles; EHS and emergency-response records may use safety_manager, emergency_response_lead, incident_commander, or field_responder.

cryptographic_hash.description: v1: null (cryptography deferred). v2: PKI-based hash.

qrm_assessment.description: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management assessment reference per skills/domains/industry/gmp/qrm/SKILL.md.

nomenclature.description: Multilingual terminology declaration. JSON keys remain English; display names support Korean + English + regulatory term.

regulatory_term_ko.description: Korean regulatory term with MFDS notice reference

risk_assessment_ref.description: Reference to a workplace risk assessment (위험성평가) per OSHA-KR Article 36. Used to trace evidence records back to the originating risk assessment.

assessment_date.description: Date the risk assessment was completed

risk_level.description: Overall risk level from the assessment

assessor_id.description: ID of the person who performed the assessment
